svg.aria-label: To-be process flow for a master data request
svg.text: To-be process: a master data request, from form to SAP Business One
Built on Microsoft 365 and SAP Business One. Approvals run in parallel; nothing reaches an approver incomplete or duplicated.
escalation to BU head and MDM
One card per approver, in parallel
Every step is written to the audit log and shown on the request tracker. Orders and enquiries in the shared mailbox go to the order desk and sales; only setup requests enter this process.
